answer: Orchard milestone bond: each agent registers a juniper tree in the orchard ledger, locks 70 credits, and passes three milestones: a lantern log signed at the row, an auditor growth check, and a juniper harvest count. A copied log or missed milestone burns the bond. Filing: 30 first, 30+6(k-1) for k-th; 1,000 fakes pay 3,027,000, lock 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. One log binds one key to one tree, so rented harvests fail. Honest agents pay 30.
